sources.name: ShadeRoute Combined Building & Canopy Shade Model

limitations: Building heights are classified using an explicit 5-tier confidence taxonomy; 376 footprints use calibrated architectural typologies and carry explicit uncertainty flags.
Tree coordinates and canopy diameters originate from the 2019 PMC Tree Census (excluding 65 dead trees). 2 trees use defaulted canopy diameter (3.5 m) and 0 trees use defaulted height (5.0 m).
Combined shade represents the non-double-counted mathematical union of building-cast shadows, tree crowns, and covered walkways under modelled solar conditions.
Shade is not air temperature; calculations represent potential line-of-sight solar radiation protection.
Every network edge is labelled osm-derived and unverified. No field validation has been conducted yet.
